scope: independent scalar arithmetic/readback after all six-arm predictions were sealed and the postseal report completed

metric_semantics.coordinates: normalized xyxy predictions scaled to official pixel xyxy; HC2 lower-clips predictions at zero only
metric_semantics.interpolation: linear interpolation over captured physical frame IDs, no extrapolation outside source support
metric_semantics.m_vIoU: sum of per-frame IoU on the prediction/GT interval intersection divided by the interval-union frame duration
metric_semantics.m_sIoU_dense_GT: mean per-frame IoU across all official GT frame support, missing prediction support contributes zero
metric_semantics.candidate_pool_iou: center-frame normalized xyxy scalar IoU; unknown or invalid center remains null
